declarations.name: AuiSpinner

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Announced (and optionally visible) label. Default: localized "Loading".

inputs.name: showLabel
inputs.description: Show the label visibly; otherwise it is visually hidden but announced.

inputs.name: delay
inputs.description: Milliseconds (integer 0..60000) before the content is shown.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Message locale for the default label.

declarations.serverRenderingNote: renders nothing on the server by design (for example until a delay elapses)

accessibility.pattern: ARIA status live region (role="status", implicit aria-live="polite").

limitations: The label is announced when content is inserted into the pre-existing status region; with delay 0 the region and content appear in the same task, so some screen readers may not announce it. Use a delay, or create the spinner on an empty host before the operation starts.
